entries.title: Hosea 13:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Ephraim's glory vanishes. 4 God's anger. 9 God's mercy. 15 The judgment of Samaria.

Ephraim. 1Sa 15:17; Pr 18:12; Isa 66:2; Lu 14:11 exalted. Nu 2:18-21; 10:22; 13:8,16; 27:16-23; Jos 3:7; 1Ki 12:25 offended. 11:2; 1Ki 16:29-33; 18:18,19; 2Ki 17:16-18 died. Ge 2:17; Ro 5:12; 2Co 5:14

entries.title: Hosea 13:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: now. Nu 32:14; 2Ch 28:13; 33:23; Isa 1:5; 30:1; Ro 2:5; 2Ti 3:13 sin more and more. Heb. add to sin. have made. 2:8; 8:4; 10:1; Ps 115:4-8; Isa 46:6; Jer 10:4; Hab 2:18,19 according. 11:6; Ps 135:17,18; Isa 44:17-20; 45:20; 46:8; Jer 10:8; Ro 1:22-25 the men that sacrifice. or, the sacrificers of men. kiss. 1Sa 10:1; 1Ki 19:18; Ps 2:12; Ro 11:4

entries.title: Hosea 13:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: know. Ex 2:25; Ps 1:6; 31:7; 142:3; Na 1:7; 1Co 8:3; Ga 4:9 in the wilderness. De 2:7; 8:15; 32:10; Jer 2:2,6 great drought. Heb. droughts. Ps 63:1

entries.title: Hosea 13:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: as a. 2Sa 17:8; Pr 17:12; Am 9:1-3 wild beast. Heb. beast of the field. Ps 80:13; Isa 5:29; 56:9; Jer 12:9

entries.title: Hosea 13:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
I will be thy king. or, Where is thy king?"King Hosea being then in prison, 2 Ki 17:4."

Ps 10:16; 44:4; 47:6,7; 74:12; 89:18; 149:2; Isa 33:22; 43:15 Jer 8:19; Zec 14:9; Joh 1:49 where. 4; 10:3; De 32:37-39; Jer 2:28 thy judges. 8:4; Jud 2:16-18; 1Sa 8:5,6,19,20; 12:11,12; 1Ki 12:20

entries.title: Hosea 13:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: he be. Ge 41:52; 48:19; 49:22; De 33:17 an east. 4:19; Ps 1:4; Isa 17:13; 41:16; Jer 4:11; Eze 17:10; 19:12 his spring. 9:11; Job 18:16; Ps 109:13; Isa 14:21 pleasant vessels. Heb. vessels of desire. Da 11:8; Na 2:9
